basis: Project-specific drawing acceptance criteria following owner feedback, not a claim of an adopted drafting standard.

requirements.name: Recognizable assembly
requirements.criterion: Show an assembled isometric or cutaway and its position on the bogie/car. Depict the actual selected mechanism and identify omitted parts. A rectangular placeholder is not a component model.

requirements.name: Part identification
requirements.criterion: Use consistent part numbers and numbered leaders tied to a bill of materials, with quantity, make/buy status, material or exact purchased part, and revision.

requirements.name: Manufacturable geometry
requirements.criterion: Give coordinated orthographic views, identified sections and enlarged details, units, scale or NOT TO SCALE, datums and all dimensions needed to make and inspect each part. Do not measure pixels.

requirements.name: Connections
requirements.criterion: Show each mating face, pilot, bolt pattern, fastener, thread, retention feature and assembly access. State supported fits, tolerances, torque or preload, and material requirements.

requirements.name: Welded assemblies
requirements.criterion: Show exact member and plate sizes, joint preparations, supported weld symbols/specifications, fabrication sequence, distortion control and inspection locations. Do not invent an unverified weld size.

requirements.name: Installation and service
requirements.criterion: Show real clearances, suspension and turning travel, guards, hose/cable routing, access and removal path. A proposed removal arrow does not establish that parts can be removed.

requirements.name: Engineering traceability
requirements.criterion: Link selections and critical dimensions to calculations, controlled manufacturer interfaces or explicit engineering decisions. Separate dimension closure from professional approval and physical test evidence.

requirements.name: Release status
requirements.criterion: Keep concept, engineering-review and fabrication-release status distinct. A complete-looking drawing with critical HOLDs is not a fabrication drawing ready for use. Record the responsible review and release evidence before marking it released.
